title: 第一卷 第3章 宫女兰心
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

叶笙歌揉了揉有些僵硬的脖颈，推开了耳房门。

房间不大，一床一桌一椅，一个简陋的衣柜，比起尚膳监的大通铺已是天上地下。

二等近侍的待遇，在这深宫，已算不错了。

他走到桌边，就着铜盆里冰冷的残水抹了把脸。冰凉刺骨，让他有些混沌的头脑清醒过来。

活下来了，但危机四伏。最要命的，还是自己这假太监的身份。

刚才在殿内，指尖触及的温软滑腻，以及她脱力靠入怀中时那淡淡的冷香，此刻不合时宜地掠过脑海。

叶笙歌猛地甩头，将那丝不该有的欲望压下。

“苏清婉的寒毒是个长期问题，必须小心控制‘疗效’，既让她离不开，又不能好得太快显得蹊跷……”

正思忖间，门外传来轻轻的叩门声。

“叶公公，歇下了吗？奉娘娘之命，来与公公说说景阳宫的规矩。”

叶笙歌整理了一下衣袍，起身开门。

门外站着一位身着浅碧色宫装的宫女，约莫十八九岁，身姿窈窕，容貌清秀，眉眼温婉，正是苏清婉身边颇为得力的大宫女之一，兰心。

“兰心姑娘，快请进。”叶笙歌侧身让开，态度恭敬。

兰心款步而入，手里捧着一套崭新的靛蓝色宦官常服和些洗漱用品。

她将东西放在桌上，目光快速而细致地扫过叶笙歌的脸，客气中带着疏离：“叶公公，这是娘娘赏你的衣物用度。”

“娘娘交代了，你既专司汤药饮食，平日不必随众上值，但景阳宫的一些基本规矩需得知晓，以免日后不慎冲撞。”

“有劳姑娘，请讲。”叶笙歌垂手而立，一副认真聆听的模样。

兰心便条理清晰地开始讲述：贵妃每日起居的时辰，喜好与忌讳，景阳宫内各处的职能与禁忌，与其他宫苑往来需要注意的礼节，见到各宫主子、各位管事公公该如何行礼问安……事无巨细，却都关乎性命。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Ye Shengge rubbed his stiff neck and opened the door to the ear room.

The room was not big, with a bed, a table, a chair, and a simple wardrobe. It was heaven and earth compared to Shang Shanjian's Datongbu.

The treatment of a second-class valet is pretty good in this deep palace.

He walked to the table and wiped his face with the cold remaining water in the copper basin.The biting coldness made his somewhat confused mind clear.

Survived, but was in danger.The most terrible thing is his identity as a fake eunuch.

Just now in the palace, the soft and smooth touch of her fingertips, as well as the faint cold fragrance when she leaned into his arms, passed through my mind at an inappropriate time.

Ye Shengge shook his head violently, suppressing the trace of unnecessary desire.

"Su Qingwan's cold poison is a long-term problem, and the 'curative effect' must be carefully controlled so that she can't live without it, but she can't get better too quickly, which makes it look strange..."

While I was thinking about it, there was a gentle knock on the door.

"Eunuch Ye, have you rested? As ordered by the empress, I came to talk to my father-in-law about the rules of Jingyang Palace."

Ye Shengge straightened his robes and stood up to open the door.

Standing outside the door was a palace maid in light blue palace clothes. She was about eighteen or nineteen years old. She had a slim figure, a delicate appearance, and gentle eyebrows. She was Lan Xin, one of Su Qingwan's most capable palace ladies.

"Miss Lan Xin, please come in quickly." Ye Shengge stepped aside with a respectful attitude.

Lan Xin stepped in, holding a brand new set of indigo eunuch uniforms and some toiletries in her hands.

She put the things on the table, glanced at Ye Shengge's face quickly and carefully, and said with a sense of alienation in her politeness: "Eunuch Ye, this is the cost of your clothes as a reward from the empress."

"The empress has told me that since you specialize in soups, medicines, and food, you don't have to follow the crowd on weekdays. However, you need to know some basic rules of Jingyang Palace to avoid accidental collisions in the future."

"Miss, please tell me." Ye Shengge stood with his hands down, looking like he was listening carefully.

Lan Xin began to talk about it in a clear and logical manner: the daily life of the imperial concubine, her likes and taboos, the functions and taboos of various places in Jingyang Palace, the etiquette that needs to be paid attention to when interacting with other palaces, how to greet the palace masters and the father-in-law when meeting... There are no details, but they are all related to life.
